description: Cronos has recovered roughly $111.2 million from the $120.4 million Tectonic exploit. The blockchain was rolled back after the attacker manipulated TONIC’s price and used the inflated token value to borrow assets. Around $9.1 million remains unrecovered.
title: Cronos Reports $9.1 Million in Unrecovered Funds After Tectonic Exploit

description: Infinix Xpad 30 Pro launched in global markets with an 11-inch display with 2.5K resolution. It runs on a MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate chip, coupled with up to 8GB of RAM and up to 256GB of onboard storage. It has an 8,200mAh battery with support for 18W fast charging. Infinix Xpad 30 Pro is available in Twilight Purple, Anthracite Grey, and Titanium Silver colourways.
title: Infinix Xpad 30 Pro Launched With MediaTek Helio G200 Ultimate SoC, 8,200mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: A US federal court has ordered the forfeiture of around $212,700 (roughly Rs. 2 crore) in stablecoins allegedly linked to a North Korean IT worker scheme. The ruling gives the US government control of funds in a wallet containing USDC and USDT, while the court declined to immediately seize other properties targeted by the Department of Justice.
title: US Court Moves to Seize $212,000 in Crypto Linked to North Korean IT Workers

description: Australia’s financial intelligence regulator has suspended, cancelled, or denied renewal of registrations for 45 crypto and remittance businesses over the past year. AUSTRAC said the actions covered dormant and insolvent firms, inaccurate registration information, unreported material changes, and entities considered exposed to higher money laundering or terrorism financing risks.
title: Australia Tightens Crypto Regulation With 45 Firms Removed

description: Apple's highly anticipated ‘Surprise and shine' event is all set to take place at Apple Park tomorrow (September 9). The Cupertino-based tech giant is expected to unveil its next-generation iPhone lineup, known as the iPhone 18 series. The company typically streams all of its launch events via its YouTube channel and website, and you can tune in when it begins tomorrow. While you wait, you can catch up on all of the last-minute leaks, from rumoured Apple Watch Series 12 features to the leaked colourways of the iPhone 18 Pro models in our live blog here.
title: iPhone 18 Series Launch Tomorrow: Catch Up on All the Last Minute Leaks LIVE

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 will launch at midnight local time in most regions and counties, PlayStation Store listings for the game have revealed. The game will first launch in New Zealand on November 18 at 11am UTC (16:30 GMT+5:30) — which is midnight local time in the country on November 19.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Global Release Timings Confirmed via PlayStation Store Listings

description: Poco C95 Pro has been listed on Beemarket, an online retailer in Uzbekistan, revealing the upcoming phone's price, colour options, key specifications, and features. The listing reveals that the phone will be available for purchase in three colour options, namely Black, Blue, and Green (translated from Uzbek). However, the company has yet to confirm these details. In terms of design, the Poco C95 Pro appears nearly identical to the recently launched Poco M8x 5G. The Poco C95 Pro has been listed with a MediaTek Helio G91 Ultra chipset, paired with an ARM Mali-G52 MC2 GPU.
title: Poco C95 Pro Listed Online Ahead of Launch, Price and Key Specifications Revealed

description: Vivo’s V80 smartphone is reportedly set to launch in India in October. The premium smartphone, which will replace the currently available V70, is expected to get notable camera upgrades, including some features from Vivo’s X series of flagship smartphones. The handset is also said to have Zeiss-branded optics.
title: Vivo V80 India Launch Tipped Online, Key Camera Details Leaked

description: BGMI will launch its limited-time collaboration with One-Punch Man on September 20. As part of the collaboration, BGMI players can claim One-Punch Man-themed rewards through redeem codes. Krafton India has released 50 codes as part of the reward drop. The codes are valid until September 25. Here is a complete list of the latest BGMI redeem codes and how to claim them.
title: BGMI One-Punch Man Redeem Codes: How to Get One-Punch Man-Themed Rewards

description: Oppo announced the launch of the Oppo F35 5G series in India via a press release. The exact launch date has not been revealed, but the teaser highlights the 'coming soon' tag. The launch could take place later this month. The official image shared by the brand shows a partial front design of the phone with a hole-punch design. The new lineup will succeed the Oppo F33 series. The Oppo F35 Pro could share a similar design and specifications with the Oppo A7 Pro Max.
title: Oppo F35 5G Series Confirmed to Launch in India Soon

description: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W, Magnetic Power Bank 10000 45W, and Power Bank 20000 165W have been launched in India, the company announced on Tuesday. The three new power banks will be available for purchase in India via Amazon, Flipkart, the Xiaomi online store, Xiaomi’s offline retail stores, Swiggy Instamart, Blinkit, and Zepto. The Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank 5000 15W is backed by a 5,000mAh battery. The power bank is 6mm thick, while weighing about 98g.
title: Xiaomi UltraThin Magnetic Power Bank Launched in India Alongside Power Bank 20000 and 10000: Price, Features

description: Huawei launched its FreeBuds 7 true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones. The latest addition to the company's FreeBuds lineup comes with active noise cancellation (ANC), spatial audio, Hi-Res audio support, and lossless audio playback. The earphones have Bluetooth 6.0 connectivity. Huawei FreeBuds 7 earphones feature three microphones.
title: Huawei FreeBuds 7 Launched With ANC and Up to 33-Hour Battery Life: Price, Features

description: OnePlus has been rumoured to expand its affordable smartphone lineup in India with a new addition to the N6 lineup. The company has now confirmed the India launch of the OnePlus N6 Lite, with a dedicated new microsite now live. It is expected to be positioned as the most affordable handset in OnePlus’ portfolio. While the company has yet to reveal a launch date or specifications, the microsite offers a first look at its design.
title: OnePlus N6 Lite India Launch Teased as Amazon Microsite Goes Live; to Get Flat Display, Green Colourway

description: Bitcoin remains below Rs. 74.8 lakh as shifting US rate expectations, higher Treasury yields, and renewed inflation concerns weigh on the recovery. Despite softer retail demand signals, analysts say the cryptocurrency has shown resilience. Traders are watching the Rs. 75.8 lakh level for a potential recovery, with Rs. 74.2 lakh emerging as key support.
title: Bitcoin Holds Below $79,000 as Rate Concerns Weigh on Recovery

description: The Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 is a big, rugged smartwatch with a 5,000-nit display, three-day battery life, smooth performance, and a comprehensive set of health and fitness features. Its size takes some getting used to, while the charging time feels slow. At Rs. 64,999, it clearly targets more serious fitness and outdoor users, but its excellent display and long battery life make it appealing even for everyday smartwatch use.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch Ultra 2 Review: Big, Bold, and Built for More Than You Need

description: Temple, the new health-tracking wearable, has finally undergone its first validation study, Deepinder Goyal announced on Monday. In the validation study, which involved 23 healthy adults, the Temple device was compared with Transcranial Doppler (TCD) results. The study found that heart rate and brain blood flow increased during cycling compared with baseline and recovery. Both Temple-BF and the TCD-measured MCAv were able to reflect these changes, showing similar brain flow trends.
title: Does Temple's Wearable Really Track Brain Blood Flow? Deepinder Goyal's Startup Shares Early Findings

description: Samsung Galaxy A07s was launched in select global markets on Monday. The handset is currently on sale in Jordan via the Samsung online store. The Samsung Galaxy A07s is offered in Black, Green, and Light Violet colour options. It can be purchased in 4GB + 64GB and 4GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration. The company promises six OS upgrades for the handset. It sports a 6.7-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) PLS LCD touchscreen. Powering the new Samsung phone is an octa-core MediaTek Helio G99+ chipset, along wth a 5,000mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy A07s Launched With 5,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung has announced offers on the Galaxy Tab S10+ in India. The Wi-Fi variant with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage is priced at Rs. 88,999. The 5G version now costs Rs. 1,03,999. The company is providing EMI offers for buyers. The Galaxy Tab S10+ features a 12.4-inch panel and runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 9300+ processor. It has a dual rear camera unit and a 10,090mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S10+ Available at Discounted Price in India: Check New Prices, Offers

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro series will be launched in India on September 15, the smartphone maker announced on Tuesday. On top of this, the microsite reveals that the Redmi Note 17 Pro series will be equipped with up to a 10,000mAh battery, highlighted with the tagline “mAhster of strength”. Citing its internal lab test results, the Xiaomi sub-brand claims that the lineup will deliver more than four days of usage on a single charge with light usage. The two new handsets will be available for purchase in India via Amazon. The purported Redmi Note 17 Pro is shown in a blue colourway, featuring a flat rear panel, with a square-shaped camera module placed in the top-right corner.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Series Launch Date Announced; Will Debut With Up to a 10,000mAh Battery

description: Realme 16 Pro 5G Harry Potter Edition was announced on Tuesday as a special edition of the company's mid-range smartphone. The new handset has been developed in collaboration with Warner Bros. Discovery and the Harry Potter franchise. As such, it brings themed design elements and software customisations while retaining the specifications of the standard Realme 16 Pro 5G.
title: Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition Announced With Hogwarts-Themed Design, Custom UI Elements

description: Ahead of the iPhone 18 Pro launch, features of the upcoming Pro models may have leaked. These appear to be Pro camera features, some of which have been available via third-party apps. Apple may showcase these new iOS 27 camera features on stage at the iPhone 18 Pro launch.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Could Get Advanced Camera Controls Including Manual Focus: Leak

description: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max was launched in China on Monday at the company's autumn flagship product launch event. The new tablet debuts Xiaomi's new Xring O3 flagship processor. It features a 13.3-inch 3.4K display with a 144Hz refresh rate and a 3:2 aspect ratio, while up to 16GB of RAM and 1TB of storage are offered. The tablet packs a 12,000mAh battery with support for 120W fast charging. Other features include an eight-speaker setup, Wi-Fi 7 connectivity and DP-in support through USB Type-C.
title: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max Launched with Xring O3 Chip, 144Hz Display: Price, Specifications

description: Huawei Pura X View has been launched in China. It ships with HarmonyOS 7.0 and runs on a Kirin 9030S chipset. It features a 6.39-inch OLED display and has a 200-megapixel primary rear camera. The Huawei Pura X View has a 7,000mAh battery. The phone comes with up to 12GB of RAM and 512GB of internal storage. It supports 66W wired fast charging and 50W wireless charging.
title: Huawei Pura X View Launched With 200-Megapixel Camera, 7,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo X500 series will be launched in China on September 21 at 7 pm local time (4:30 pm IST), the smartphone maker announced on Monday during the Vivo Creator Festival. This comes shortly after the Vivo Product Manager Han Boxiao revealed that the Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max will be capable of recording videos at up to 4K/240 fps. Moreover, the two smartphones will be able to capture 4K resolution video at 120 fps in HDR mode. The phones are expected to be powered by the unreleased MediaTek Dimensity 9600 series chipsets.
title: Vivo X500 Series Launching September 21 in China With X500, X500 Pro and Pro Max

description: MediaTek has finally revealed the launch timeline for its Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. It will be MediaTek’s first 2nm processor. Rumours indicate that a select few smartphone manufacturers will have access to the new chipset. In a Weibo post, MediaTek has detailed some of its key features.
title: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Launch Date Confirmed for September 15, Key Features Teased

description: iQOO has announced that its next-generation flagship smartphone, dubbed iQOO 16, will launch later this month. The upcoming handset is confirmed to be powered by Qualcomm’s next-generation flagship mobile SoC, along with a new in-house gaming chip. It will be accompanied by the iQOO Pad Ultra, which is teased to feature an 8.8-inch OLED display, flagship Qualcomm hardware and active cooling. Both devices are being positioned around sustained gaming performance.
title: iQOO 16 China Launch Confirmed for September; iQOO Pad Ultra to Tag Along

description: Capcom has announced that Onimusha: Way of the Sword has sold over 1 million copies. The action-adventure game reached the sales milestone on the day of its release. Onimusha: Way of the Sword is the first title in the series in 20 years.
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Sells 1 Million Copies on Day of Release

description: Apple is gearing up to host its ‘Surprise and Shine’ event tomorrow, where it is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, alongside the much-awaited book-style foldable dubbed iPhone Ultra. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a short video appearing to show retail demo units has surfaced online, offering what could be the clearest look yet at two rumoured colour options of the purported iPhone 18 Pro models.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Dark Cherry, Blue Colours Allegedly Leak in New Video Ahead of September 9 Event

description: Motorola recently launched the Edge 70 Max in India at a starting price of Rs. 54,999. The smartphone competes with the iQOO 15R and OnePlus 15R, offering decent performance and fighting for the spot of the best premium mid-ranger. With a great AMOLED display, impressive charging speed, performance, and battery life,  it becomes one of the top contenders in its price bracket. However, its hefty form factor and passable camera performance weigh it down.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Max Review: Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Performance Without the Flagship Price
